name: Snare - Tripwire touched
description: A planted Snare tripwire (decoy tool, honey credential, canary document or link) was used. No legitimate workflow touches one. Treat the source as compromised or misdirected until shown otherwise. Severity 1 (Informational) is excluded: that is the sink test alert.
false_positives: A person testing their own tripwires.

name: Snare - Several tripwires touched by one source
description: One source touched two or more different Snare tripwires within an hour: an agent working through planted traps.
false_positives: Several people behind one NAT address each testing a tripwire.
